_comment: Skill gates: observable tool events that require an agent skill to have been loaded this session. Single source of truth consumed by the shared core (~/.agents/guardrails/core.ts, createSkillGate) across Claude, pi, and opencode; matching lives in core.ts, the host adapter supplies the session evidence of skill loads (Claude: transcript scan; pi/opencode: watching tool payloads for SKILL.md reads). Each gate's `trigger` is one of: {type:bash, command, subcommands?} | {type:write, path_glob, at_root?, except?} (Write/Edit) | {type:fetch, domains} (WebFetch). Every miss fails open. Add a gate here once; all three agents pick it up (a host that can't see the tool simply fails open for that gate). `message` states ONLY the event that tripped the gate — never what the skill contains; the skill name comes from `skill` and its purpose lives solely in its own description (avoids cross-source drift).
